final: WITH r AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name AS Name, SUM(t.Bytes) * 1.0 / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name) SELECT Name, rate, track_count, rate - (SELECT AVG(rate) FROM r) AS above_avg FROM r WHERE rate > (SELECT AVG(rate) FROM r)
